data.name: Cults of the Endtimes
data.detailed_description:
Forge the Idol You do not play as a god — you create one. An Egregore is an entity woven from collective psychosis, faith, and despair. You have hundreds of starting dogmas at your disposal. Will your savior be a bloodthirsty tyrant? A silent observer? Or something that has no name in human tongues?

The Evolution of Faith Forget micromanagement and building construction. Your weapon is the Idea. Ideas have a life of their own: they cross-breed, mutate, and spawn monstrous hybrids of belief. The faith of the flock is the flesh of your deity. If your followers crave blood, your god will twist to provide it. You guide the current, but you do not always control the flood.

War for the Fading Mind The world is dying. Literally. Time is running out. But you are not alone. Other cults seek to ascend their own egregores. This is a Darwinian battle of ideologies set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. In the end, only one will remain.

About the Demo: The First Ritual

This is an introductory fragment of the coming End Times.

  • Session Duration: 5–10 minutes of concentrated gameplay (The full version targets 40–50 minute sessions).

  • Mechanics: Simplified rituals and a foundational set of dogmas.

  • The Goal: To introduce you to the basics of cult creation and the system of mutating ideas.

  • The full version will feature a deep event system, expanded magic, and an unpredictable Storyteller engine that weaves a unique narrative of the world's demise in every playthrough.

data.short_description: The world is in agony. The only salvation is faith. Forge a god from the fears and hopes of a dying humanity. Spread your ideas like a virus, mutate dogmas, and battle other egregores for the last souls on Earth. A strategy game about manipulating consciousness without direct control.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: The game is optimized for low-end laptops and integrated graphics.

  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: The game is optimized for low-end laptops and integrated graphics.

content_descriptors.notes: The game explores mature philosophical themes, including nihilism, existential dread, and the collapse of societal morality. It depicts cults that may pursue extreme hedonism and carnal desires as a response to the impending apocalypse. These themes are conveyed primarily through text, environmental storytelling, and abstract imagery. There is no explicit visual depiction of sexual acts or nudity; however, the narrative deals with heavy psychological elements and the dark side of human nature in the face of oblivion.
